title: single alert export defaults to the JSON tab with a single object and downloads a .json
verifies: the dialog opens on JSON, renders a single object (not an array), and Download writes <name>.json with the success toast and close

title: single alert export Terraform tab renders openobserve_alert and downloads a .tf
verifies: the Terraform tab renders an openobserve_alert resource (header comment, alert label, enabled) and Download writes <name>.tf

title: bulk export produces a JSON array and one Terraform resource per alert
verifies: multi-item export yields a JSON array, one openobserve_alert resource per convertible alert, and a date-stem alerts-YYYY-MM-DD.tf filename

title: copy button copies the active tab code to the clipboard
verifies: the copy button copies exactly the active tab's code to the clipboard for both JSON and Terraform

title: Terraform and OpenTofu registry links render in the Alerts header
verifies: the Terraform/OpenTofu registry badges render in the Alerts header and link out in a new tab

title: dropped provider-incompatible field is reported while the resource still renders
verifies: an alert with having.ignore_case reports the dropped field in the info banner while the resource still renders

title: re-opening the dialog always lands back on the JSON tab
verifies: closing and re-opening the dialog resets the tab to JSON on every open
